guides.title: 先做光功率帳本，再談連線能否工作
guides.titleEn: Build an optical power budget before judging a link
guides.concept: 光學互連包含光源、調變、耦合、傳輸、偵測與電子電路。光功率足夠只是必要條件之一；頻寬、雜訊、抖動與誤碼表現還需要另外證據。先定義功率量測的起點與終點，才能公平比較配置。
guides.conceptEn: An optical interconnect includes generation, modulation, coupling, transmission, detection and electronics. Adequate optical power is only one requirement; bandwidth, noise, jitter and error performance need separate evidence. Define the start and end of power measurements before comparing architectures.
procedure: 畫出發射器到接收器的功能鏈，在每個光／電轉換處分界。標示雷射是外接還是整合案例，並記錄使用哪個來源作為架構依據，不假設所有矽光子都採同一光源。
建立損耗表：耦合器、波導、彎曲、連接器與分光等項目分列。對長度相關損耗，先確認資料單位是 dB/m 還是 dB/cm，再乘上對應長度。
用 Prx(dBm) = Ptx(dBm) − ΣL(dB) 計算簡化接收功率；若加入分光，列出理想分配與額外損耗。缺少可追溯數字時，保留符號或明確標示自訂教學值。
把接收器靈敏度、飽和界限、目標資料率和測試條件列在另一欄。只有條件相符時才計算餘裕；沒有接收器文件時，不能把正的光功率直接稱為連線通過。
改變一項耦合損耗或路徑長度，觀察餘裕趨勢，再列出此帳本缺少的頻寬與誤碼驗證。說明零觀察到錯誤仍需測試位元數和信賴度背景。
procedureEn: Draw the transmitter-to-receiver chain with boundaries at optical/electrical conversions. Identify an external or integrated laser in the chosen reference architecture; do not assume all silicon photonics uses the same source.

Build a loss table for couplers, waveguides, bends, connectors and splitters as applicable. For length-dependent loss, check whether the unit is dB/m or dB/cm before multiplying by the matching length.

Calculate a simplified received power with Prx(dBm) = Ptx(dBm) − ΣL(dB). For splitters, distinguish ideal division from excess loss. Keep symbols or explicitly educational values when traceable numbers are unavailable.

List receiver sensitivity, saturation limit, target data rate and test conditions separately. Calculate margin only for matching conditions; without receiver documentation, nonzero optical power cannot establish a working link.

Vary one coupling loss or path length to inspect margin trends, then list missing bandwidth and error-rate verification. Explain that observing zero errors still requires bit-count and confidence context.
evidence: 提交帶量測邊界的功能圖、單位一致的損耗表與來源／假設標記。用一個例子說明 dBm 是功率基準，而 dB 是比值。
結論分成「光功率預算可行」與「通訊品質仍待驗證」，不能把前者當作誤碼測試結果。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional diagram with measurement boundaries, a unit-consistent loss table and source/assumption labels. Use an example to distinguish absolute dBm power from a dB ratio.
Separate optical-budget feasibility from communication quality still requiring verification; the former is not a bit-error-rate result.
pitfalls: 直接相加 dBm 值來合併不同光源。
漏掉耦合界面或把波導長度單位弄錯。
只看總雙向頻寬而忽略每方向和每通道的定義。
pitfallsEn: Adding dBm values directly to combine optical sources.
Omitting coupling interfaces or mismatching waveguide-length units.
Using aggregate bidirectional bandwidth without defining directions and lanes.

guides.scope: 原創教學工作單；使用本網站示意圖，並自行準備或從所列來源取得圖表、量測或模擬資料。沒有提供晶圓廠製程配方，也沒有內建本題的實測資料。
guides.scopeEn: Original educational worksheet. Use the site schematics and figures, measurements or simulation data you supply or obtain from the references. This is not a foundry recipe, and no measured dataset for this exercise is bundled.

guides.title: 環形共振器：讀懂共振、線寬與溫度漂移
guides.titleEn: Ring resonators: interpret resonance, linewidth and thermal drift
guides.concept: 環形共振器依靠光在環路中累積的相位與耦合來選擇波長。共振位置、線寬、損耗與耦合不是同一個參數；溫度或製程變異也可能讓工作點偏移。這份練習使用圖表與公開模型概念，不宣稱網站內建完整電磁求解器。
guides.conceptEn: A ring resonator selects wavelengths through round-trip phase and coupling. Resonance position, linewidth, loss and coupling are distinct quantities; temperature or fabrication variation can shift the operating point. This exercise uses plots and public model concepts, not a claimed built-in full-wave electromagnetic solver.
procedure: 畫出單匯流排環形結構並標示 through port；若改用 add-drop 結構，另外標出 drop port。先預測共振時在哪一個埠看見凹谷或峰值，再對照所選模型的埠定義。
從自行取得或參考來源的傳輸頻譜讀出相鄰共振位置與半高全寬。記錄座標是波長還是頻率，以及訊號是功率還是場振幅，避免用不同定義直接計算。
在適用定義下估算 FSR 與 loaded Q ≈ λres / Δλ，並標示取樣解析度。若頻譜點太稀，回報線寬無法可靠解析，不把插值曲線當作新增量測。
用共振條件與有效折射率的概念，預測改變環路長度或溫度會移動共振位置。對溫度掃描，固定其他假設，並說明調諧所需功率及跨通道熱影響仍待資料。
比較兩條相同正規化方式的頻譜，區分共振位置偏移、凹谷深度改變與線寬改變。提出損耗或耦合變化等不同假說，說明僅一條頻譜可能無法唯一反推出所有參數。
procedureEn: Draw a single-bus ring and label the through port. For an add-drop structure, label the drop port separately. Predict which port shows a dip or peak at resonance, then check the selected model’s port definitions.

Read adjacent resonance positions and full width at half maximum from spectra you supply or obtain from references. Record wavelength versus frequency axes and power versus field amplitude before calculating.

Where definitions apply, estimate FSR and loaded Q ≈ λres / Δλ, recording sampling resolution. If sampling is too sparse, report unresolved linewidth instead of treating interpolation as new measurement.

Use the resonance condition and effective-index concept to predict shifts with ring length or temperature. Hold other assumptions fixed in a temperature sweep and identify missing tuning-power and thermal-crosstalk data.

Compare two consistently normalized spectra to distinguish shifted resonance, changed dip depth and changed linewidth. Propose loss and coupling hypotheses and explain why one spectrum may not uniquely determine every parameter.
evidence: 提交有埠標示的原創圖、兩條具有來源或假設標記的頻譜比較，以及 Q 與 FSR 的定義和單位。
指出資料解析度與參數可辨識性的限制；能解釋峰／谷差異，而不是背誦某一種曲線形狀。
evidenceEn: Submit an original port-labeled drawing, a two-spectrum comparison with provenance or assumption labels, and Q/FSR definitions and units.
Identify resolution and parameter-identifiability limits; explain peak/dip behavior rather than memorizing one curve shape.
pitfalls: 把 through port 的凹谷和 drop port 的峰值搞混。
用場振幅半高代替功率半高而不說明。
將 loaded Q 當成單獨材料吸收損耗。
pitfallsEn: Confusing through-port dips with drop-port peaks.
Substituting field-amplitude half-height for power half-height without explanation.
Treating loaded Q as material-absorption loss alone.

guides.title: 矽光子與 CPO 光引擎：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Silicon Photonics and CPO Optical Engines: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 光引擎由光源、調變、偵測、封裝與控制共同構成。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: An optical engine combines source, modulation, detection, packaging and control. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：光引擎由光源、調變、偵測、封裝與控制共同構成。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：建立端到端功率、頻寬、溫度與失效預算。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: An optical engine combines source, modulation, detection, packaging and control. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Build end-to-end power, bandwidth, thermal and failure budgets. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「建立端到端功率、頻寬、溫度與失效預算」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Build end-to-end power, bandwidth, thermal and failure budgets, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 矽光子與 CPO 光引擎：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silicon Photonics and CPO Optical Engines: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「分辨光與電介面」建立判讀邊界。光傳輸搬運資訊，驅動、接收與控制仍需電子電路。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Distinguish optical and electrical interfaces to define the interpretation boundary. Optical transmission carries information while drivers, receivers and control remain electronic. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分辨光與電介面：光傳輸搬運資訊，驅動、接收與控制仍需電子電路。 在系統圖區分光路、電路與控制路徑。
觀察站 2｜分離鏈路參考面與插入損耗：假設參考功率 1.00 mW，輸出 0.25 mW，IL=10 log10(1/0.25)=6.02 dB；此值仍包含未去嵌耦合器。
觀察站 3｜交付可重現 CPO 設計審查：最小封包包含有單位輸入、公式、假設、輸出圖、來源 URL 與未解議題；模擬不得標為量產實測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish optical and electrical interfaces: Optical transmission carries information while drivers, receivers and control remain electronic. Separate optical, electrical and control paths in the system diagram.
Observation station 2 | Separate reference planes and insertion loss: With hypothetical reference 1.00 mW and output 0.25 mW, IL=10 log10(1/0.25)=6.02 dB; unremoved coupler loss remains included.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a reproducible CPO review: A minimal package includes inputs with units, formulas, assumptions, plots, source URLs and open issues; simulation must not be labeled production measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分離鏈路參考面與插入損耗」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付可重現 CPO 設計審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate reference planes and insertion loss: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a reproducible CPO review to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 把熱調諧控制線當成高速資料線，會混淆頻寬需求。
重新插拔參考線後未重校正，會把治具漂移當元件變化。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Treating a thermal-control line as the high-speed data path confuses bandwidth requirements.
Reconnecting without rereferencing makes fixture drift appear to be device change.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.summary:
AIM Photonics 於 2015 年成立，其羅徹斯特測試、組裝與封裝中心在 2018 年成為重要的能力節點。這個選址把積體光子的研究接到羅徹斯特既有的光學與光子產業背景，也把「晶片畫得出來」與「光能可靠地接進接出」之間的落差放到眼前。

矽光子的故事不只在晶圓內。光纖連接、晶粒整合、量測與封裝會決定原型能否成為可驗證的系統。地圖標示 TAP 場址；AIM Photonics 在 Albany 也有相關活動，因此這裡代表封裝與測試的一環，並非整條產業鏈的唯一地點。
courses.summaryEn:
AIM Photonics was established in 2015, and its Rochester Test, Assembly and Packaging facility became an important capability milestone in 2018. The location connects integrated photonics with Rochester’s optical-industry background and exposes the gap between designing a chip and coupling light into and out of a dependable system.

Silicon photonics extends beyond the wafer. Fiber attachment, integration, measurement, and packaging determine whether a prototype becomes a testable system. The map marks TAP; AIM Photonics also operates in Albany, so Rochester represents a packaging-and-test link rather than the entire chain.

courses.connection: 從地圖上的封裝中心回到耦光損耗、對準、調變、光偵測與熱漂移。練習區分晶片內部性能與封裝完成後的端到端光鏈路性能。
courses.connectionEn: Link the packaging center to coupling loss, alignment, modulation, detection, and thermal drift. Distinguish on-chip performance from end-to-end performance after packaging.
